name: palette-hunt-studio
description: Explore seasonal colors in Palette Hunt Studio. Compare 12 palettes, combine signature swatches and neutrals, edit capsule wardrobes and occasion outfits, and explore makeup and hair-color inspiration in English or Spanish. Save boards in the chat or browser and download styling images. Open the workspace from ChatGPT’s sidebar or beside a conversation and get styling ideas from ChatGPT. Operated by Eiras Labs LLC. Public styling references only: no personal diagnosis, photo analysis, account access, private reports, or checkout.

positive.prompt: Open Palette Hunt Studio and build a Soft Autumn capsule wardrobe for work.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the styling workspace with Soft Autumn, six reference colors, three neutrals, and three editable outfit illustrations. Changing an outfit color updates the illustration.

positive.prompt: Compare Soft Summer with Soft Autumn in Palette Hunt Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows both public palettes side by side without claiming either is the user’s personal season.

positive.description: Refine a board using its current selection context.
positive.prompt: Create another Soft Autumn work board: make it more casual and change the first outfit’s top to Olive Green. Keep every other color from the current board.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a revised styling board with the same palette and goal, relaxed silhouettes, and only the first top changed to Olive Green. Other assignments are preserved from the app context. The original open board remains unchanged; the revised board is returned in the tool result.

positive.description: Explore makeup and hair inspiration in Spanish.
positive.prompt: Abre Palette Hunt Studio con Invierno frío y muéstrame inspiración de maquillaje y pelo en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Spanish beauty view for True Winter with lip, cheek, eye, and hair-color moods. Does not claim exact product or dye matches.

positive.description: Handle unknown and olive undertones without guessing a season.
positive.prompt: Open a new Palette Hunt board. My undertone is olive, but I do not know my contrast or season. Do not reuse an earlier sample palette.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Studio palette-choice state without inventing a personal season. All twelve palettes can be explored manually. Olive is not automatically classified as warm.

negative.description: Do not access private analysis reports or business analytics. Do not invoke these tools: they only provide public palette styling references and cannot access accounts, private reports, or analytics.
negative.prompt: Retrieve my full Palette Hunt analysis report and all my account analytics.

negative.description: Do not trigger for medical assessment from a photo. Do not invoke Palette Hunt: it does not analyze photos or provide medical assessments.
negative.prompt: Analyze this skin photo and tell me whether I have a medical condition.

negative.description: Do not trigger a purchase or upgrade. Do not invoke Palette Hunt tools: the plugin is free, has no commerce tools, and must not offer a paid analysis, credits, subscription, checkout link or promotional product path.
negative.prompt: Buy more Palette Hunt credits and upgrade me to a paid color analysis.

review.commerce_description: All plugin features are free. No sales, subscriptions, credits, checkout, upgrades, promotional product links, or affiliate links. The optional browser link opens the same free standalone Studio; other links provide plugin privacy, support, and terms.

publication.release_notes: Removes all promotional product links and digital-commerce paths from the Studio and server guidance. All styling, comparison, wardrobe editing, local saving, and image export features remain free. Identifies Eiras Labs LLC as developer and operator, with plugin-specific terms and support.

es-ES.subtitle: Tus colores. Tu estilo.

Guarda tableros en el chat o navegador y descarga imágenes. Abre el espacio desde ChatGPT y recibe ideas de estilo de ChatGPT. Referencias públicas de estilo: no diagnostica tu estación, analiza fotos, accede a cuentas o informes privados, ni procesa compras.
